# Sparsh Edits — Sparsh Sharma

> Short-form video editor and AI reel creator based in Bengaluru, India. Sparsh Edits helps brands, creators, and agencies turn raw footage into scroll-stopping Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and social content.

- Brands in India needing consistent Reels and Shorts
- Restaurants and cafés in Bengaluru wanting food reels and promo content
- Creators and personal brands needing talking-head and podcast clip editing
- Agencies looking for white-label short-form video editing

- Instagram Reels editing (Bengaluru & India)
